The device features a black front faceplate with a white click wheel interface and a reflective screen area. It is partially enclosed in a translucent blue protective silicone case. A cardboard box is visible in the blurred background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The translucency and refraction of light through the blue silicone case appear slightly inconsistent, with some edge bleeding into the wooden background, suggesting minor rendering imperfections in the material simulation.

The labels on the click wheel (Menu, Play/Pause, etc.) are extremely faint and lack sharp definition, appearing slightly warped rather than crisp printed text, which is common in AI generations of small text.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation and verify it matches the 'iPod' class label against look-alike MP3 players.
To audit the boundary between the solid iPod body and the translucent case, checking for fusion artifacts or incorrect layering.
To verify the physical separation between the iPod/case and the wooden table, ensuring no 'melting' into the surface.
To assess the realism of reflections on the glossy screen and the texture of the silicone case.

focus_areas: Integrity of the click wheel geometry and text legibility
Realism of the translucent case material (refraction/transparency)
Sharpness of boundaries between the device, case, and background
Consistency of reflections on the glossy screen surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the click wheel. AI often fails to render these tiny labels correctly. Also, scrutinize the interaction between the blue case and the iPod body; ensure the case doesn't merge into the device's ports or buttons unnaturally.
